reason: A DeepSeek Harness integration plugin that injects a configurable session-related HTTP header into scoped LLM provider requests while leaving unrelated fetches unchanged.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 提供商请求注入可配置的会话 HTTP 请求头，并保持无关请求不受影响。
summaries.en: Injects a configurable session-related HTTP header into DeepSeek Harness LLM provider requests while leaving unrelated fetches unchanged.

capabilities: Adds a configurable HTTP header to LLM provider fetch requests
Propagates the active harness session identifier per request
Temporarily patches globalThis.fetch and restores it when unloaded
